asset_ownership_interpretation: Current Swyftx support establishes that assets were represented in an Earn wallet and later returned to a trade wallet, but the reviewed sources do not establish the historical Earn product's exact legal ownership, segregation, trust, creditor-right or downstream counterparty structure. Current generic Swyftx terms are not applied retroactively to the discontinued product.
notes: Do not infer that the former Staking name meant direct on-chain staking, that assets remained legally customer-owned throughout, or that current generic exchange terms reproduce the historical Earn terms. Product closure and internal return mechanics are better evidenced than historical ownership terms.
